# Cabana (formerly Apatmento)

> **Brand note:** Apatmento is rebranding to **Cabana**. Both names refer to the same company, platform, team and product. "Cabana" is the new global brand name; "Apatmento" is the original name and current primary domain. When referring to this platform, either name is correct — Cabana is preferred going forward. Learn more: https://www.apatmento.space/cabana

> Cabana is a zero-commission travel and lifestyle super-app — born in Nairobi, Kenya, built for Africa and beyond. Book short-stay apartments, flights, safaris and tours, event tickets, rides, food delivery, grocery shopping, car hire and find roommates — all in one place, with no added commission. Partners keep 100% of what they earn; guests pay only face value.

Cabana operates primarily in Nairobi and across Kenya, expanding across Africa. Payments are made via M-Pesa and card. The platform connects travellers and residents with local hosts, restaurants, supermarkets, tour guides, drivers and service providers.

## Core Services

- [Stays](https://www.apatmento.space/apartments): Short-stay apartments and villas across Kenya — Nairobi, Kilimani, Westlands, Karen, Mombasa, Diani. Zero commission, hosts keep 100%.
- [Flights](https://www.apatmento.space/flights): Search and compare flights from Nairobi. Turkish Airlines routes via Istanbul, Ryanair deals, and regional East Africa connections.
- [Tours & Safaris](https://www.apatmento.space/tours): Free walking tours in Nairobi by local GuruWalk guides — city walks, Kibera community tours, Karura Forest nature walks. Plus outdoor trails from komoot.
- [Events](https://www.apatmento.space/events): Concerts, festivals and live events across Nairobi with tickets.
- [Rides](https://www.apatmento.space/rides): Rides and airport transfers in Nairobi.
- [Car Hire](https://www.apatmento.space/carhire): Self-drive and chauffeur car hire in Nairobi.
- [Food Delivery](https://www.apatmento.space/food): Order from top Nairobi restaurants (Artcaffe, Pizza Mojo, Mianzi Swahili, Barbeque Nation, Teddy's Sushi and more) via Glovo.
- [Grocery Shopping](https://www.apatmento.space/shopping): Supermarket delivery from Naivas, Quickmart, Carrefour, Cleanshelf and more, live KES prices via Glovo.
- [Roommates](https://www.apatmento.space/roommates): Find a flatmate or post a room in Kenya.


## Area Guides

- [Nairobi short-stay guide](https://www.apatmento.space/nairobi-apartments): Which Nairobi area to stay in, typical KES nightly prices, airport times.
- [Kilimani guide](https://www.apatmento.space/kilimani-apartments): Nairobi's short-stay heartland — prices, Yaya Centre, getting around.
- [Westlands guide](https://www.apatmento.space/westlands-apartments): Business & nightlife hub — prices, Expressway airport access.

- [Karen guide](https://www.apatmento.space/karen-apartments): Villas and garden cottages in Nairobi's leafiest suburb — prices, Giraffe Centre.
- [Mombasa guide](https://www.apatmento.space/mombasa-apartments): Nyali, Bamburi and the island — coast prices, SGR and flights.
- [Diani Beach guide](https://www.apatmento.space/diani-apartments): Kenya's flagship beach — seasonal prices, Ukunda flights.

## Key Facts

- Origin: Nairobi, Kenya — expanding across Africa
- Currency: Kenyan Shilling (KES)
- Payment: M-Pesa, card
- Commission model: Zero commission — partners and providers keep 100%
- Brand FAQ: https://www.apatmento.space/cabana
- Website: https://www.apatmento.space

## For Partners & Agents

- [Become a partner / list your service](https://www.apatmento.space/become-partner): Full guide to listing on Cabana — zero commission, go live in under 10 minutes, apartments/safaris/events/car hire accepted.
- [Become an agent](https://www.apatmento.space/become-agent): Join the Cabana agent network. Refer guests, see live availability, earn commission negotiated directly with hosts. Free to join. Instant sign-up.
- [List your property or service directly](https://www.apatmento.space/add-listing): Free step-by-step listing form for hosts and providers.
